heading: Three invalid deliveries had passed verification.
scope: A diagnosis of 96 saved simulated attempts separates missing evidence from incorrect quality claims. Keeping more information recovered missed opportunities, but did not make the verification claims reliable.

requiredText: Each compact method lost two observable opportunities through bounded retention.
Four of 22 eligible verification claims disagreed with stipulated artifact validity.
The accepted diagnosis selects preparation of a dated evidence-quality protocol.

results.label: Information lost in storage
results.measure: observable opportunities in either compact method
results.summary: The two methods missed different opportunities. Both complete-record controls recovered them; the original comparison remains tied.

results.label: Verification and outcome
results.measure: eligible claims disagreed with stipulated validity
results.summary: Three positive claims accompanied invalid artifacts. Every method accepted those three simulated deliveries. An authenticated claim did not establish quality.

limits: One hand-designed synthetic batch, diagnosed from retained evidence without rerunning a candidate. These frequencies do not estimate real verifier performance. Local hashes establish consistency, not an independent witness of time or truth.

next.question: What evidence makes a delivery checkable?
next.description: Prepare one future artifact delivery with fixed acceptance criteria, exact contents, and a separately implemented quality check.
next.budget: Retain who made each claim, what it concerned, and when it was available. Preparation does not establish predictive benefit or authorize live exchange.
